Iris (marketing): Quick notes from RefApp OSS launch this morning (07:48 PT). Community traction good. Thinking a short webinar + gated appendix to drive dev signups.
Ben (devrel): Nice—numbers?
Iris (marketing): 12h: 3.2k pageviews, 240 newsletter signups, 11 repo stars, 6 demo requests.
Maya (growth): Demo breakdown? startup vs enterprise?
Oli (content): 5 startups, 1 mid-market, 0 enterprise. Most signups from inline CTA.
route-bot: 2 leads failed routing: missing "utm_source" -> parked in manual-review.
Sam (ops): Can default missing utm_source -> "organic" and tag 'auto-defaulted' so SDRs can filter. Will patch staging first.
Ben (devrel): Also: article lists ~latency numbers measured batch=1. Let's add a clear bench note about batching vs throughput so we don't mislead readers.
Oli (content): I'll add a bold callout: "Latency measured at batch=1 on dedicated nodes; batching increases tokens/sec. Full bench configs in the appendix."
Maya (growth): Proposed webinar: "RefApp in Practice: deploy, benchmarks, and cost tradeoffs". Target 50 devs. A/B CTAs on page: "Register live" vs "Get repo + appendix".
Iris (marketing): Action items:
- Oli: update post copy + add CTA variants (EOD)
- Sam: implement utm default + reprocess the 2 leads (today)
- Ben: draft webinar outline + confirm Rafael for runtime deep-dive (tomorrow)
- Maya: create reg page + promo plan ($600) in 48h
Sam (ops): Reprocess command I'll run after prod deploy:
```bash
python infra/reprocess_leads.py --filter "missing_utm_source" --assign default:organic --tag auto-defaulted
```
Ben (devrel): Proposed agenda: 10m intro, 20m demo, 15m benchmarks, 10m Q&A. Rafael to cover runtime tradeoffs.
Maya (growth): I'll track CTA A/B -> CTR -> reg -> demo funnel. If B drives more downloads than live regs, gate appendix post-webinar.
Iris (marketing): Please update this thread when tasks are complete so SDRs can pick up leads. :rocket:
